entities.name: Jiang Yanggu
entities.description: An amnesiac human, former planeswalker, centered in green mana, always accompanied by the sapient dog Mowu.

entities.name: Mowu
entities.description: Yanggu's sapient dog, who turned into a stone statue after the battle on Ravnica.

entities.name: Shenmeng
entities.description: Plane of Yanggu's earliest memories.

entities.name: Jiuli Clan
entities.description: A clan haunted by plague that Yanggu sought to save.

entities.name: Ten Wizards Mountain
entities.description: Where Yanggu ventured seeking a solution to the plague.

entities.name: Mu Yanling
entities.description: A water mage who battled and then befriended Yanggu.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where the War of the Spark was fought.

entities.name: Interplanar Beacon
entities.description: Lured planeswalkers to Ravnica.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who invaded Ravnica with the Dreadhorde and trapped planeswalkers with the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact Bolas used to trap planeswalkers; disabled by Chandra.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas's army of Eternals.

entities.name: Jace
entities.description: Recommended that planeswalkers split into teams.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: Planeswalker who volunteered to protect civilians.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Planeswalker who volunteered to protect civilians.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Helped evacuate civilians with the Golgari Swarm.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Guild that helped evacuate civilians.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: Disabled the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group Yanggu helped in the fight against Bolas.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: Event during which Yanggu lost his spark.

entities.name: Echoverse Jiang Yanggu
entities.description: Echoverse version whose spark never ignited, who craved vengeance after Mowu was killed.

events.summary: Yanggu wakes with no memories and renames himself after the first place he remembers.
events.quote: After waking up with no memories, he didn't know his name or family.

events.summary: Yanggu ventures into Ten Wizards Mountain to save the Jiuli Clan from plague, battling and befriending Mu Yanling.
events.quote: Here he battled, and later befriended, the mysterious water mage Mu Yanling .

events.summary: Yanggu and Mu Yanling are lured to Ravnica and trapped by Bolas's Immortal Sun.
events.quote: immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Yanggu, Mu Yanling, Ajani and Huatli volunteer to protect and rescue civilians, evacuating many to the tunnels with Vraska and the Golgari Swarm.
events.quote: they were able to evacuate many civilians to the tunnels beneath the city

events.summary: Yanggu remains on Ravnica after Chandra disables the Immortal Sun, helping the Gatewatch fight Bolas.
events.quote: helping the Gatewatch in their fight against Bolas

events.summary: After Bolas's defeat Mowu turns into a stone statue and Yanggu and Yanling leave Ravnica among the first.
events.quote: with Mowu turning into a stone statue before both he and Yanggu disappeared

events.summary: Yanggu loses his spark in the Desparkening but keeps traveling with Mowu via the Omenpaths.
events.quote: Yanggu lost his spark during the Desparkening

events.summary: In the Echoverse, Mowu is killed by unknown assailants and Yanggu abandons his peaceful ways for vengeance.
events.quote: When Mowu was killed by unknown assailants, Yanggu cast aside his peaceful ways, craving only vengeance.

relations.note: always accompanied by his sapient dog
relations.quote: is always accompanied by a sapient dog named Mowu
he went onto the journey of expedition with Mu Yanling

relations.note: fought Bolas's Eternals and helped the Gatewatch
relations.quote: he fought against the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde
